title: Describe each listed tool with dated attributes and capability coverage
requirements:
- Add per-tool fields: supported standards/profiles, conformance evidence, version and date assessed
- For client-registry tools, distinguish registration, matching, deduplication and inclusive-registration support
- Replace narrow HMIS/PHSP listings with a platform-level entry mapped to the capabilities it can co-realise
- Distinguish terminology servers from model-governance tools such as CKM
- Add a reference table mapping tools such as ODK, CommCare and OpenSRP to components
- Add an illustrative tool example for the Benefits Package Registry
- Add licensing (software and content), maintainership/governance and support model
- For LHR repositories, identify supported LHR capabilities and that access-control/consent need deployment assessment
